objective: Audit the v0.2.0 public package for component-map lifecycle safety, append-only scan logging, distribution parity, and bounded paper-facing claims.

elements.target: A missing accepted map produces only a provisional candidate and an append-only history event.

evidence.observed: The candidate was created; accepted-map.json was absent.

elements.safe_interpretation: Discovery cannot silently establish the accepted structural authority.

elements.target: An unchanged accepted map is checked and reused without a replacement candidate or delta.

evidence.observed: Reconciliation returned checked_unchanged with no candidate or delta.

elements.safe_interpretation: Existing accepted structure is verified rather than rebuilt on every scan.

elements.target: Source drift or same-ID semantic conflict emits candidate/delta evidence while preserving the accepted map.

evidence.observed: Both cases produced append-only evidence and left accepted-map.json byte-identical.

elements.safe_interpretation: The tested drift and conflict paths fail safe against silent authority replacement.

elements.target: Element-level evidence method, check status, claim status, interpretation, and repair are persisted hierarchically.
elements.safe_interpretation: The tested component-to-element map and append-only scan-record invariants pass locally.

elements.target: The expanded package does not break active repository contracts.
elements.safe_interpretation: All currently collected repository regression tests pass with the v0.2.0 package.

elements.target: Skill metadata and referenced resources in staging, export, Downloads, and installed copies.

evidence.observed: All four invocations returned Skill is valid.

elements.safe_interpretation: Each distributed installable skill copy passes the official structural validator.

elements.target: README distinguishes deterministic behavior evidence from cross-project reliability and general RAG benefit.

evidence.locator: Research status and Paper-facing evaluation plan
evidence.observed: General reliability and general RAG improvement remain explicitly unclaimed.

elements.safe_interpretation: The public claims remain bounded to tested behavior and one outcome-known project.

elements.target: General reliability across projects, agents, models, and domains.
elements.safe_interpretation: Deterministic fixtures and one outcome-known project do not establish general reliability.
elements.required_repair: Run a frozen, independently labelled, multi-project comparative evaluation.

elements.target: Final authorship, repository URL, DOI, and author-approved software license.

evidence.observed: Release identity and license remain unresolved.

elements.safe_interpretation: The package is paper-facing but not yet an identified open-source release.
elements.required_repair: Supply release metadata and add an author-approved LICENSE.

strongest_safe_claim: The v0.2.0 skill is structurally valid, and deterministic tests establish the tested component-map lifecycle and append-only element-level logging invariants.
claim_boundary: Cross-project reliability, independent scientific replication, and general RAG improvement remain unestablished.
unresolved_uncertainties: Final authorship, repository, DOI, and license metadata are pending.
